overview.title: Verifiable parental consent
overview.intro: Before a student's account can use covered features, review the direct notice and complete a verifiable consent step for that child.
overview.emptyText: Add a student in your family profile first — then come back here to complete consent.

studentScreen.activeBanner: This student's covered features are active.
studentScreen.pendingBanner: Covered features stay off for {name} until consent is recorded and activation is confirmed.
studentScreen.adultLearnerBanner: {name} is an adult learner. Parental consent does not apply — activation only requires the family link.
studentScreen.activateIntro: This is a separate, deliberate step from recording consent.

notice.title: Direct notice to parents
notice.intro: This describes exactly what we collect about {name} if you give consent, why, and your rights. This notice is separate from, and not satisfied by, agreeing to our general Terms of Service.

categories.identity_profile: Basic identity details (preferred name, grade level, age band or birth month/year)
categories.academic_records: Academic records (lessons, assignments, grading, progress notes)
categories.contact_info: Contact information needed to reach your family about tutoring
categories.communications: In-app messages and scheduling communications, always parent- and staff-visible
categories.payment_billing: Billing records tied to the lessons you purchase

notice.purposeText: Solely to operate tutoring for your child: scheduling lessons, tracking academic progress, and billing you for the service. We do not sell this information.
notice.retentionText: Your consent record itself is never automatically deleted — we keep it as long as needed to demonstrate compliance, even after you unenroll.
notice.rightsText: You may review what we collected, request its deletion, or withdraw consent at any time by contacting support — withdrawing consent pauses this student's covered features.
notice.acknowledge: I have read and understood this notice.

form.title: Complete verifiable consent
form.intro: This step is separate from, and required in addition to, acknowledging the notice above.
form.methodHint: Only the methods your family can currently complete are selectable.
form.typedFullNameHint: Type your name exactly as it should appear on this record.
form.attestationLabel: Type the attestation below exactly as written

feedback.consentRecorded: Consent recorded. You can now activate this student's covered features.
feedback.activated: Covered features are now active for this student.

errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this student.
errors.notFound: The requested student was not found.
errors.contactVerificationRequired: Verify your email and phone before completing consent.
errors.consentNotApplicable: This student is an adult learner and does not need parental consent.
errors.methodNotSupported: That verification method is not available yet.
errors.verificationFailed: We could not verify that submission. Check the typed name and attestation and try again.
errors.consentRequired: A valid consent record is required before activation.
errors.familyNotReady: The family record is not ready for activation yet.
errors.accountSuspended: This account is suspended and cannot be activated here.
errors.invalid: Check the highlighted information and try again.
errors.generic: The change could not be saved. Try again.
